subtitle: Procedures after the verdict
author: Moses Maimonides
intro: Rambam's Commentary on the Mishnah in the original 12th-century Judeo-Arabic. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a dictionary gloss.

aligned.ja: בדבריו אינו יורד משם לעולם. ולא יסמע מן אלשאהד כלאם בין לזכות בין לחובה לקולה ועד לא יענה.
aligned.en: In his words, he never descends from there [the witness stand] again. And no witness is heard, whether to acquit or to convict, on account of the verse *And one witness shall not testify* (Numbers 35:30).

pairs.en: he never descends from there [the witness stand] again
witness
whether to acquit or to convict
on account of the verse *And one witness shall not testify*

aligned.ja: וקולה בנפש למות, אנמא הו עלי אחד, כאנה יקול אחד לא יענה בנפש למות.
aligned.en: The phrase *against a person, to die* refers to a single [witness]; it is as though Scripture said: a single witness shall not testify against a person, to die.

pairs.en: The phrase *against a person, to die*
refers to a single [witness]
it is as though Scripture said
a single witness shall not testify against a person, to die

aligned.ja: ולד'לך לא יקתל חתי יכון המחייבין יזידון על המזכין את'נין פמא זאד כמא בינא פי אלפרק אלד'י קבל הד'א.
aligned.en: For this reason one is not put to death unless the convicting [judges] exceed the acquitting [judges] by two beyond [the bare majority], as we explained in the chapter preceding this one.

pairs.en: one is not put to death
the convicting [judges]
exceed the acquitting [judges] by two

pairs.ja: כמא בינא פי אלפרק אלד'י קבל הד'א
pairs.en: as we explained in the chapter preceding this one

aligned.ja: משנה [ה]
aligned.en: Mishnah 5

aligned.ja: הד'א כלה בין, וקד תקדם לנא ד'כר אצלה לאן הטותך לטובה על פי אחד, ולרעה על פי שנים פמא זאד.
aligned.en: All of this is clear, and we have already set out its underlying principle, namely that your inclination toward the favorable [verdict] proceeds upon the word of one, and toward the unfavorable upon the word of two beyond [the majority].

pairs.en: All of this is clear
its underlying principle
your inclination toward the favorable [verdict] proceeds upon the word of one

pairs.ja: ולרעה על פי שנים פמא זאד
pairs.en: toward the unfavorable upon the word of two beyond [the majority]

aligned.ja: פרק. ששי.
aligned.en: *Chapter Six.*

aligned.ja: משנה [א]
aligned.en: Mishnah 1

aligned.ja: אלעלה אלתי לאג'להא כאן בית הסקילה חוץ לבית דין כי לא יט'הר לאלחכאם חרץ עלי אלקתל, ופי סירה אלי מוצ'ע אלקתל קד יכון ת'ם מן יעלם לה זכות.
aligned.en: The reason the place of stoning was set outside the court is so that no eagerness to carry out the execution should become apparent on the part of the judges, and so that, in the course of the procession to the place of execution, there might still be someone who knows grounds for his acquittal.

pairs.en: The reason
the place of stoning was set outside the court
the procession to the place of execution
grounds for his acquittal

aligned.ja: ושרח סודרין, ראיה. וקולה שיהא ממש בדבריו, חיניד' מחזירין אותו אפילו ארבעה וחמשה פעמים, אמא פעם ראשונה ושניה פירד אד'א קאל יש לי ללמד על עצמי זכות ואפילו לא היה ממש בדבריו, לאנא נקול מן שדהֵ אלכ'וף אנסי חג'תה, ורבמא אד'א רג'ע לבית דין ואסתקרת נפסה יתד'כר חג'תה.
aligned.en: The explanation of *sudarin* is: banners [signal-cloths]. As for his statement that there must be *substance in his words* — at that point [a fourth or fifth recall] *they bring him back even four or five times*; but on the first and second occasions he is brought back when he says *I have grounds to argue for my own acquittal* even if there was no substance in his words, for we say that out of the intensity of his fear he forgot his argument, and perhaps when he returns to the court and his mind settles he will recall his argument.

pairs.en: The explanation of *sudarin* is: banners [signal-cloths]
there must be *substance in his words*

pairs.ja: מחזירין אותו אפילו ארבעה וחמשה פעמים
pairs.en: *they bring him back even four or five times*

pairs.ja: יש לי ללמד על עצמי זכות
pairs.en: *I have grounds to argue for my own acquittal*
out of the intensity of his fear he forgot his argument

aligned.ja: ופי ג'מלהֵ אלנדא איצ'א יקול ושהד עליה שהודה אלד'ין הם פלאן ופלאן אן פעל אלפעל אלכד'א פי יום כד'א וסאעהֵ כד'א פי אלמוצ'ע אלפלאני, איאך יכון ת'ם מן יזים אותם.
aligned.en: Within the proclamation [of the herald] it is also stated: "So-and-so testified against him — namely the witnesses, who are So-and-so and So-and-so — that he committed such-and-such an act on such-and-such a day, at such-and-such an hour, in such-and-such a place," lest there be someone who can refute them as conspiratorial witnesses.

pairs.en: the proclamation [of the herald]
the witnesses, who are So-and-so and So-and-so

pairs.ja: פעל אלפעל אלכד'א פי יום כד'א
pairs.en: he committed such-and-such an act on such-and-such a day
refute them as conspiratorial witnesses

aligned.ja: וכמא יעמל פי אלסקילה יעמל פי ג'מיע מיתות בית דין.
aligned.en: And just as is done in stoning, so is done in all the modes of execution imposed by the court.

pairs.en: just as is done in stoning
all the modes of execution imposed by the court

aligned.ja: משנה [ב]
aligned.en: Mishnah 2

aligned.ja: אלד'י אוג'ב אן יתודה רחוק מבית הסקילה, כילא יפזע ותצ'טרב נפסה ולא ימכנה אלכלאם אד'א קרב מן מוצ'ע אלקתל.
aligned.en: What requires that he make confession at a distance from the place of stoning is so that he not be seized with terror and his mind become agitated, leaving him unable to speak once he draws near to the place of execution.

pairs.en: that he make confession at a distance from the place of stoning
be seized with terror and his mind become agitated
unable to speak
he draws near to the place of execution

aligned.ja: ואעלם אן קתל יהושע לעכן אנמא כאן הוראת שעה, לאן שריעתנא אלחאקה לא תוג'ב אלקתל עלי אלמד'נב באקרארה, ולא בגורל, ולא בוחי נבי אנה פעל ד'לך אלפעל.
aligned.en: And know that the execution of Achan by Joshua (Joshua 7) was a temporary directive [horaat shaah], for our true Law does not require that the offender be put to death on the basis of his own admission, nor by lot, nor by the revelation of a prophet that he committed that act.

pairs.en: the execution of Achan by Joshua
a temporary directive [horaat shaah]
our true Law

pairs.ja: לא תוג'ב אלקתל עלי אלמד'נב באקרארה
pairs.en: does not require that the offender be put to death on the basis of his own admission
nor by lot
nor by the revelation of a prophet

aligned.ja: ואין הלכה כר' יהודה.
aligned.en: And the law is not in accordance with Rabbi Judah.

aligned.ja: משנה [ג]
aligned.en: Mishnah 3

aligned.ja: יסתר אלרג'ל מן תחת אלסרה. ואלד'י אוג'ב אן ירג'ם עריאן לאנה אסרע למותה.
aligned.en: The man is stripped from below the navel. What requires that he be stoned naked is that it is quicker for his death.

pairs.en: The man is stripped from below the navel
he be stoned naked
quicker for his death

aligned.ja: ואין הלכה כר' יהודה.
aligned.en: And the law is not in accordance with Rabbi Judah.

aligned.ja: משנה [ד]
aligned.en: Mishnah 4

aligned.ja: אלרג'ם או אלדחי ען מוצ'ע מרתפע סוי, לאן וקוע אלחג'ר עליה או וקועה הו עליהא אלאלם ואחד, אלא תרי קולה סקול יסקל או ירה יירה.
aligned.en: Stoning, or pushing him down from an elevated place, are equivalent, for whether the stone falls upon him or he himself falls upon it, the pain is one and the same — do you not see [Scripture's] expression *he shall surely be stoned or shot through* (Exodus 19:13)?

pairs.en: Stoning
pushing him down from an elevated place
the stone falls upon him
he himself falls upon it
the pain is one and the same
*he shall surely be stoned or shot through*

aligned.ja: משנה [ה]
aligned.en: Mishnah 5

aligned.ja: ר' אליעזר יסתדל מן קולה והומת ותלית אותו, כל המומתין נתלין. ואלחכמים יסתדלון מן קולה קללת אלהים תלוי מגדף פקט, ועובד ע"ז תסמי איצ'א מגדף הו קולה והנפש אשר תעשה ביד רמה מן האזרח ומן הגר את ה' הוא מגדף וג'אנא אלתפסיר פי ספרי אן תלך אלפרשה בג'מלתהא פי עבודה זרה ג'את.
aligned.en: Rabbi Eliezer adduces a proof from the verse *and he be put to death and you hang him* (Deuteronomy 21:22): all who are put to death are [also] hanged. But the Sages adduce a proof from the verse *for a curse of God is one hanged* (Deuteronomy 21:23) — only the blasphemer [is hanged]. And the idolater is likewise called a blasphemer, as in the verse *But the person who acts with a high hand, whether native-born or stranger, he reviles the Lord* (Numbers 15:30) — *he is a blasphemer*; and the interpretation has come down to us in the Sifrei that that entire passage was stated concerning idolatry.

pairs.en: Rabbi Eliezer adduces a proof from the verse
*and he be put to death and you hang him*
all who are put to death are [also] hanged
the Sages adduce a proof
the idolater is likewise called a blasphemer
the interpretation has come down to us in the Sifrei

aligned.ja: וצלבן האולא אלנסוה עלי אלכשוף וקתלהן כלהן פי יום ואחד הוראת שעה, וכד'לך צלבהן הוראת שעה, ולא יתעלם חכם מן הוראת שעה כמא אצלנא פי צדר תאליפנא הד'א.
aligned.en: The crucifixion [hanging] of these women upon the gibbet [exposed], and the execution of all of them on a single day, was a temporary directive; and likewise their being hanged was a temporary directive. No legal ruling is to be derived from a temporary directive, as we laid down as a principle at the outset of this composition of ours.

pairs.en: The crucifixion [hanging] of these women upon the gibbet [exposed]
the execution of all of them on a single day
a temporary directive

pairs.ja: לא יתעלם חכם מן הוראת שעה
pairs.en: No legal ruling is to be derived from a temporary directive

pairs.ja: כמא אצלנא פי צדר תאליפנא הד'א
pairs.en: as we laid down as a principle at the outset of this composition of ours

aligned.ja: ואין הלכה כר' אליעזר.
aligned.en: And the law is not in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer.

aligned.ja: משנה [ו]
aligned.en: Mishnah 6

aligned.ja: אלחכמים יקולון לא יג'וז אלצלב עלי שג'רה מגרוסה לקול אללה תקברנו, מי שאינו מחוסר אלא קבירה יצא זה שמחוסר קציצה וקבירה, לאן מן אלאצול אלמנקולה אן אלעוד אלד'י יצלב עליה ידפן מעה. וכד'לך כל מא יתנאול בה קתל הרוגי בית דין ידפן מעהם.
aligned.en: The Sages hold that hanging upon a tree rooted [in the ground] is not permitted, on account of God's word *you shall surely bury him* (Deuteronomy 21:23) — one who lacks nothing but burial, excluding this one, who lacks both cutting down and burial; for it is among the received principles that the timber upon which one is hanged is buried together with him. And likewise everything by means of which the court's executions are carried out is buried together with them.

pairs.en: hanging upon a tree rooted [in the ground]
on account of God's word *you shall surely bury him*
one who lacks nothing but burial
lacks both cutting down and burial
the received principles

pairs.ja: אלעוד אלד'י יצלב עליה ידפן מעה
pairs.en: the timber upon which one is hanged is buried together with him

aligned.ja: ור' יוסי יקול איצ'א לא תדפן אלכ'שבה אלמרכוזה פי אלארץ' לאנהא מחוסרת חפירה פלד'לך יקול מטה על הכותל ולא תרכז פי אלארץ'. ואלחכמים יקולון חפירה לאו מלתא היא. והלכה כחכמים.
aligned.en: Rabbi Yose, too, says that the post fixed in the ground is not to be buried, since it lacks [the act of] digging out; for this reason he says [the gibbet must be made by] leaning [a beam] against a wall and not by being planted in the ground. But the Sages say: [the need for] digging is no consideration. And the law is in accordance with the Sages.

pairs.en: the post fixed in the ground
it lacks [the act of] digging out
leaning [a beam] against a wall
not by being planted in the ground
[the need for] digging is no consideration
the law is in accordance with the Sages

aligned.ja: משנה [ז]
aligned.en: Mishnah 7

aligned.ja: מה הלשון אומרת, יעני אי שי עאדת אלאנסאן אן יקול אד'א אראד יעאקב מן יתאלם באלמה אן לא ראחה פי הד'א אלפעל ולא פי תרכה, וכאן אלקול אלד'י יקאל פי זמאן ר' מאיר פי הד'א אלמעני קל אני מראשי קל אני מזרועי.
aligned.en: *What does the tongue [common usage] say?* — that is, what is a person accustomed to say when he wishes to chastise one who is grieved by some affliction that brings him no relief either in the doing of this deed or in the leaving of it undone. The saying that was current in the days of Rabbi Meir on this theme was: "My head is heavy upon me [literally: light upon me], my arm is heavy upon me."

pairs.en: *What does the tongue [common usage] say?*
what is a person accustomed to say
one who is grieved by some affliction

pairs.ja: לא ראחה פי הד'א אלפעל ולא פי תרכה
pairs.en: no relief either in the doing of this deed or in the leaving of it undone

pairs.ja: אלקול אלד'י יקאל פי זמאן ר' מאיר
pairs.en: The saying that was current in the days of Rabbi Meir

aligned.ja: כד'לך קאל אללה אן פי קתל הד'א אלעאצי כ'ראב וג'וד ותרכה איצ'א לא יצלח. פאד'א קיל הד'א פי מסתחק אלקתל פנאהיך מן קתל ברי.
aligned.en: Just so does God say: in the execution of this offender there is a ruin of being, and in leaving it undone there is likewise no fitness. Now if this is said of one who deserves death, how much more so [is the grief] over the killing of the innocent.

pairs.en: the execution of this offender
a ruin of being
in leaving it undone there is likewise no fitness
one who deserves death
the killing of the innocent

aligned.ja: והד'ה אלשתי קבורות הלכה גמירי לה, וליס להא שאהד ולא עלקה פי אלנץ אלא מג'רד אלנקל.
aligned.en: As for these two burial-grounds [for the executed], they are a law transmitted to Moses [at Sinai], having no scriptural proof-text and no attachment in the [scriptural] text, but resting solely upon the tradition.

pairs.en: these two burial-grounds [for the executed]
a law transmitted to Moses [at Sinai]
having no scriptural proof-text
no attachment in the [scriptural] text
resting solely upon the tradition

aligned.ja: משנה [ח]
aligned.en: Mishnah 8

aligned.ja: הקרובים באים, ענד נפאד' אלחכם עליה וקתלה. ולא ילזם אלאבל עלי הרוגי בית דין,
aligned.en: *The relatives come* — when the sentence has been carried out against him and he has been put to death. And no mourning is undertaken for those executed by the court,
